content.json:
## CrowdStrike Falcon Endpoint Protection Overview
Use this workbook to review authentication activity, detections, and high-risk endpoint events. The views below are driven by the workbook parameters so analysts can quickly focus on specific hosts, users, tactics, and time ranges.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.query:
CrowdStrikeFalconEventStream
| where EventType == "AuthActivityAuditEvent"
| distinct Activity
| sort by Activity asc

parameters.name: TargetUserName
parameters.label: Target User
parameters.query:
CrowdStrikeFalconEventStream
| where EventType == "AuthActivityAuditEvent"
| distinct DstUserName
| sort by DstUserName asc

content.query:
CrowdStrikeFalconEventStream
| where EventType == "AuthActivityAuditEvent"
| where Activity in ({Operation}) or '*' in ({Operation})
| where DstUserName in ({TargetUserName}) or '*' in ({TargetUserName})
| summarize Total = count() by Activity, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Total Events by Operation over Time
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected time range and filters. Verify the data connector is enabled and data is flowing.

items.name: Total Events by Operation over Time

parameters.name: Hostnames
parameters.label: Hostname
parameters.query:
CrowdStrikeFalconEventStream
| where EventType == "DetectionSummaryEvent"
| distinct DstHostName
| sort by DstHostName asc

parameters.name: Usernames
parameters.label: Username
parameters.query:

content.json:
## How to use this workbook
Start with the summary tiles and trend charts, then drill into the tables for critical detections, failed events, and top hosts/users. Adjust the parameters at the top of the workbook to narrow the scope of investigation.

content.query:
CrowdStrikeFalconEventStream
| where EventType == "DetectionSummaryEvent"
| where DstHostName in ({Hostnames}) or '*' in ({Hostnames})
| where DstUserName in ({Usernames}) or '*' in ({Usernames})
| where Activity in ({Tactics}) or '*' in ({Tactics})
| where SensorId in ({SensorId}) or '*' in ({SensorId})
| where Severity in ({Severity}) or '*' in ({Severity})
| summarize ['Total Detections'] = count() by EventType
content.title: Total Detections
content.noDataMessage: No data found for the selected time range and filters. Verify the data connector is enabled and data is flowing.
